description: Alfred’s protocol outputs MUST be valid UTF-8 JSON/NDJSON. When encountering non-UTF8 filesystem paths or OS-specific path encodings, Alfred MUST handle them safely and report them deterministically (e.g., escaped/encoded representations) rather than crashing or producing invalid JSON.
name: UTF-8 Protocol and Path Encoding Handling
